messages.text: The "single" test fails because when the input is `"7"` (no hyphen), `split("-")` returns `["7"]`, so `to` is `undefined`, and `Number(undefined)` is `NaN`. The fix is to handle the case where there's no delimiter by defaulting both values to the same number.

response.text: Both tests now pass. The issue was that `parseRange("7")` — a hyphen-less range — wasn't handled. When `text.split("-")` on `"7"` returns `["7"]`, `to` becomes `undefined`, which when passed to `Number()` produces `NaN`. The fix checks if the text has no delimiter and defaults `to` to `from` in that case.
